title: Why Trevor Philips never became a pilot in GTA 5
subject: trevor
description:
Would Trevor have turned out different if he'd made it into the air force? 👇

How a failed psych evaluation, Michael Townley and one job in North Yankton made Trevor Philips. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto V.

scenes.text: Trevor Philips wanted to fly fighter jets.
He grew up in Canada, and the air force was his way out. Then he failed the psych evaluation.
He drifted into crime instead, pulling robberies with Michael Townley.
They were partners for years, until a bank job in Ludendorff, North Yankton, in 2004.
Trevor got away. He was told Brad went to prison and Michael was dead.
He disappeared into the desert near Sandy Shores and built Trevor Philips Enterprises out of meth and guns.
He never got his jet, but nobody in Blaine County flies like Trevor.
